exposure: hypoplastic left heart syndrome with aortic atresia
cohort: 57 neonates with hypoplastic left heart syndrome (HLHS) or HLHS variants
finding: In neonates with HLHS, male sex with aortic atresia and lower total brain maturation score were associated with an increased risk of preoperative white matter injury.
mod_finding: While 31% of the cohort was delivered by cesarean section, mode of delivery was not significantly associated with preoperative PVL.
